The robot starts with a brief settle pose, then extends its arm forward and outward in a controlled manner, creating a clear and welcoming gesture.
reasoning:
# Q1: A human performs this motion by extending their arms outward and slightly upward, palms facing forward, conveying openness and readiness to welcome someone or something.
# Q2: Candidates comparison: P1) front+horizontal+x55,y50,z50, P2) up+horizontal+x50,y50,z60, P3) left+vertical+x40,y60,z50; winner=P1 because the front-facing horizontal alignment naturally aligns with the open-arm gesture, making it the most intuitive and readable.
# Q3: Structure comparison: M1 P1>path(line x)>path(line y), M2 P1>movement(x+y), M3 P2>path(line x)>pose; winner=M1 because the sequential extension along the x-axis followed by a lateral spread along the y-axis creates a more deliberate and welcoming motion compared to a single combined movement or an unexpected upward start.
# Q4: Context reinforcement: Options=C1 preparatory settle before the open arms, C2 final settled pose after the open arms, C3 slight lean forward before the open arms; winner=C1 because a brief settling pose before the open arms reinforces the intentionality of the gesture, making it feel more deliberate and heartfelt.
